answer: Cap each identity at 8 attested actions per epoch and price its bond at 20 POA, so a 500-wallet farm buys 4,000 actions for 10,000 POA and still shows zero distinct evidence, because a quorum drawn from unrelated subnetworks compares the receipts and voids the group. That is arithmetic, not cleverness: at the wharf the bond costs more than a copied action earns, so throughput hits its zenith at 4,000 slots while the ivory ledger records one behaviour repeated five hundred times.
